caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent drinking mug with a handle, rendered in delicate shades of yellow and brown. The mug has a cylindrical shape with slightly curved sides that taper inward toward the top. The handle, attached to the mug’s side, arches outward and connects at two points with rounded, ornamental ends. The glass is colored with faint yellow highlights and subtle brown shading, indicating transparency and thickness. At the bottom center of the mug, an oval-shaped impression is visible, suggesting the texture of the glass. The background is plain cream or light beige. Below the mug, there is a horizontal scale marked from 0 to 3 units, with evenly spaced increments, and to the right of the scale is a small signature and symbol. The entire composition is centered on the page, with the mug occupying the upper central region.
title: Mug
